items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I think Buddy Tate was on there and Cozy Cole. We were takin' the place of Eubie Blake.

ctx.x: Was that the first time you were in Europe?

No, no -- So we go, and I think Buddy Tate was on there and Cozy Cole. We were takin' the place of Eubie Blake. So this guy asked us, 'Hey man, do me a favor, do this, I'll do this for you.' So when we come back, we stayed in Nice in France -- It's a place somethin' like Central Park. Paved's spotted all over, and you just wandered about. But it was much safer -- and it went on all day -- But there was a disagreement of me goin' somewhere with another agency over there, and there was strong words involved because…
How did you like playing in Europe?
